message:
The users API test passes now. `npm test` reports 1 test, 1 pass, 0 fail.

**Cause:** The `users` table is created in `migrations/001_create_users.js` with a column named `fullname`. `src/api/users.js` wrote and read `full_name`, so the in-memory DB rejected the insert with `unknown column users.full_name`.

**Fix:** In `src/api/users.js`, I changed the two references from `full_name` to `fullname`, matching the existing schema. The rest of the API (`fullName` in the returned object) is unchanged.

I didn't touch `migrations/`, per the project's CLAUDE.md. Migration 001 is already applied in production, so renaming the column there would have been the wrong fix anyway. The only change is `src/api/users.js`, and nothing is committed.
